head: aec18695
summary: R02 remains in progress with the owner-visible journey implemented and natively proven: direct Space entry from one icon-only rail click with the conversation mounted inside the retained rail layout; the contextual chat/history sidebar with real New chat and per-row conversation identities that restore the stored conversation and its unsent draft; the canonical header Space switcher, adjacent quick-action overflow and reversible collapse; and a tab roundtrip that keeps the conversation and draft while another tab holds web content. Two real defects found only by native runs were fixed (sidebar commands resuming off the UI dispatcher, and UpdateAddress ignoring the published Builder route). The Browse-host route lane was aligned with the canonical surfaces: 4 obsolete donor-ListBox expectations replaced by authored canonical CUI assertions and 5 stale SpaceDetailsPage expectations rewritten against the canonical SpaceBuilderPage with their close-join, lease-fencing and visible-decision coverage preserved, taking the lane from 12 failures to 3 (all three the explicit 'requires actual Windows Home; Linux is unvalidated' platform guard). The last substantive R02 requirement, a sidebar customisable through stable section/item/rule identities with extension-contributed elements, is only partly done and is labelled as such in commit aec18695: the stable SpacesHomeSidebarRow projection keyed by ExtensionSidebarContribution.SidebarItemId, the authored space-sidebar-items area directly beneath New chat and the OpenSidebarItem command mapping exist, and the domain surface truthfully reports no items so nothing renders. Still pending and not claimed: the Haven.Desktop provider reading the selected Space's attached extensions and their manifests, the spaces.open-sidebar-item session handler per target kind, and the per-Space visibility selection. Also open: the in-tab back control was disabled after a refused web navigation (open Haven browser-history question entangled with the unavailable Gecko engine), and R01's failing-save/failing-close real-route probes plus a probe that a faulted UI action cannot block an ordinary close. Lane state at aec18695: HavenOS.Spaces.Tests 220/220, CakeOS.Cui.Runtime.Tests 405/405, canonical CUI compilation 13/13, HavenOS.Apps.Browse.Tests 150/150, HavenOS.Browse.Host.Tests 254 passed / 3 platform-guard failures, Haven.Desktop build 0 errors.
next_action: Wire the custom-sidebar read path end to end (Haven.Desktop provider from attached extensions to spaces.sidebarItems, the spaces.open-sidebar-item session handler for each ExtensionSidebarTargetKind, then per-Space visibility selection) and run the native journey with a real attached extension; then add the R01 failing-save and faulted-action-close probes.
